d: Binds an enemy with a Crimson Tether that drains it for 3 turns (2 mana).

spell.h: (an enemy hero 2-3 away) to bind it.
spell.d: bind an enemy hero 2-3 away. At the start of your next 3 turns it loses 2 HP and the Hemomancer heals 2 (3 and 3 with the Vampire team bonus). It breaks if they end a turn more than 4 apart, a wall blocks the line, or she is silenced, caged or slain. Her move is 1 while it holds and the target stays revealed. One tether at a time.
